player_prompt.intro:
Uyindlela {player_id} emdlalweni wa {num_rounds}-round wa Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Vuyelo byaku kuwa kuwina swirondzo ngi swin'wana.
Enchoveni ya kila swirondzo, u tekela na yin'we ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', kuya '[scissors]'.
U na ku kota ku usa '[r]', '[p]', kuya '[s]' tanihi kuxiyixa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Xiyimo xa wu hambanisiwa. Usa [rock], [paper], kuya [scissors].

message.round_win: Vuyelo bya xirhendzevutana: Mutlangi {winner} wa hlula!

outcome.p0_wins: Mutlangi wa 0 u wine mimphikizano yo tala!
outcome.p1_wins: Mutlangi wo sungula u wine mimphikizano yo tala!
outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu ve na ku ringana!
